drum.measurement_interpretation: Vertical height, not projected circular area. Datum is the existing local hull roof at the drum station on the centerline, excluding raised trim.
drum.instruction: Lower the drum into the existing hull; join its lower region with compact continuous shoulders. Preserve the native cockpit and selected forward hull. Determine the absolute lowering after establishing the actual drum envelope and local roof.

engines.instruction: Start by lowering both engines and their seats by the same vertical offset as the drum, preserving their pair spacing, scale and fore-aft exhaust direction. Refit the supports to the lowered assembly.

geometry_revision.mechanical_constraint: Keep the native baydoor trajectory at its existing height. Its measured sweep reaches Y=1.33448 and Z=2.90127; reserve the receiving corridor through the revised lower drum/base between the engines. Clearance is not yet validated in new geometry.
